How a project runs

  1. 1

    Idea

    We test your concept quickly and cut it down to what matters.

  2. 2

  3. 3

    Build

    Clean, typed code on a solid architecture.

  4. 4

    Launch

    We ship to the stores and the web, and stay on call for launch week.

  5. 5

    Grow

    Analytics, performance work and regular updates.
